changelog.title: The Hive — Basement Level 1
changelog.description: A new survival horror dungeon crawler. Navigate 19 rooms of an abandoned underground facility with fog-of-war map, atmospheric descriptions, and Red Queen antagonist.

changelog.title: SVG Map Engine
changelog.description: Full interactive map with fog of war, pan/zoom, click-to-move, movement trail, room type coloring, and CRT scan line overlay.

changelog.title: Puzzle Integration
changelog.description: Compression Vault terminal puzzle wired into the dungeon. Solve it to unlock the storage room. Save/resume preserves partial puzzle progress.

changelog.title: Red Queen AI
changelog.description: Antagonist dialogue system with ambient commentary every 8 moves, room-specific taunts, depth-tier corruption effects, and click-to-dismiss.

changelog.title: 21 Quality-of-Life Features
changelog.description: WASD/arrow navigation, ESC to exit puzzles, backspace to go back, blinking terminal cursor, autosave indicator, discovery toasts, CRT flicker, and more.
